% ── Sections ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
\section{Introduction}

This paper presents a simple OLS regression analysis. The data were
generated synthetically and processed through a three-step SCons
pipeline: import, clean, and analyze. The results are automatically
incorporated into this document.

\section{Data}

The dataset contains $\obsN$ observations with variables $x$ and $y$.
The data were generated with a known linear relationship
$y = \coeffConst + \coeffX x$, allowing us to verify the correctness
of the regression output.

\section{Results}

Table~\ref{tab:regression} presents the OLS regression results.
The estimated coefficient on $x$ is $\hat{\beta} = \coeffX$
(standard error $\seX$), and the constant term is
$\hat{\alpha} = \coeffConst$ (standard error $\seConst$).
The model explains $\rsq$ of the variation in $y$ ($N = \obsN$),
exactly recovering the true data-generating process.
